National University of Río Cuarto (Universidad Nacional de Río Cuarto - UNRC) is a public university located in the city of Río Cuarto, Argentina. It was founded in 1971 and is one of the most prestigious institutions of higher education in the country.

UNRC offers a wide range of undergraduate and postgraduate programs in various fields of study, including agriculture, engineering, social sciences, humanities, and natural sciences. The university has several faculties, schools, and research centers that provide students with opportunities for academic and professional development.

The university is known for its strong emphasis on research and innovation, with many faculty members actively involved in cutting-edge research projects. UNRC has partnerships with other universities and research institutions both in Argentina and abroad, which allows students and faculty to collaborate on international research initiatives.

In addition to its academic programs, UNRC also offers a range of extracurricular activities, including sports, cultural events, and community service projects. The university campus is equipped with modern facilities, including libraries, laboratories, and sports facilities, to support the academic and personal development of its students.

Overall, the National University of Río Cuarto is a leading institution in Argentina that is committed to providing high-quality education, research, and community engagement opportunities for its students and faculty.
